snippet.title: 『Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story』 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story" is a sound novel game where you work alongside Satone, a girl who loves writing stories. Customize lo-fi music, ambient sounds, and landscapes to create a focused environment. As you deepen your bond with Satone, you may discover a special connection with her.

【Steam Store Page】
